newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares realign, eyes now on FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares realign, eyes now on FOMC.

text.p: The Belgian Bel-20 .BFX ended the first session after its reweighting lower, as share prices continued to adapt to the shuffle and with losses on Wall Street in the afternoon taking the index to the day's lows.
"It is a show of how unstable prices were at the close on Friday -- it's a technical move more than anything," one dealer said. The index fell 14.42 points or 0.82 percent to 1,750.64.

Bekaert, which had suffered at the prospect of having its Bel-20 weighting reduced, ended 0.9 percent higher at 23,300 francs. UCB, which has suffered a similar fate, rose 0.2 percent to 60,000 with 4,159 shares traded.

All eyes now are focused on Tuesday's meeting of the policy-making Federal Reserve Open Market Committee, with market opinion divided on whether it will result in a hike in the short term, Fed funds rate - and if so, by how much.
In a Reuters poll last week a small majority of economists questioned expected a rate rise - and almost all of those expected the increase to be 25 basis points.
"I say there will not be a rate rise. But if there is, then I hope it is a half point and not a quarter point, becasue that really would give the market a signal," one dealer said.
